activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Massive nature park featuring the iconic Supertrees, climate-controlled cooled conservatories, and diverse plant life.

activities.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
activities.description: A 158-year-old tropical garden and Singapore's first UNESCO World Heritage Site, featuring the National Orchid Garden.

activities.name: National Museum of Singapore
activities.description: The nation's oldest museum with progressive curation, showcasing Singapore's history and culture through immersive exhibits.

activities.name: ArtScience Museum
activities.description: Iconic lotus-inspired building hosting major international exhibitions fusing art, science, culture, and technology.

activities.name: Sentosa Skyline Luge
activities.description: Gravity-fuelled cart ride down specialized tracks with hairpin turns and tunnels on Sentosa Island.

activities.name: S.E.A. Aquarium
activities.description: One of the world's largest aquariums housing more than 100,000 marine animals across multiple distinct habitats.

activities.name: Singapore Flyer
activities.description: Giant observation wheel offering panoramic views of the Marina Bay skyline and parts of Malaysia and Indonesia.

activities.name: Asian Civilisations Museum
activities.description: Museum dedicated to the material history and cultures of Asia, particularly the ancestral cultures of Singaporeans.

activities.name: Cloud Forest
activities.description: A mysterious world veiled in mist, featuring a 35-meter tall mountain covered in lush vegetation and the world's tallest indoor waterfall.

activities.name: National Gallery Singapore
activities.description: Visual arts institution housing the world's largest public collection of Singapore and Southeast Asian modern art.

activities.name: Singapore River Cruise
activities.description: Traditional bumboat tour along the historic Singapore River passing iconic landmarks and modern skyscrapers.

activities.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
activities.description: Ornate Buddhist temple and museum in Chinatown built to house the tooth relic of the historical Buddha.

activities.name: Fort Canning Park
activities.description: Historical hilltop park with ancient artefacts, spice gardens, and lawns that host outdoor concerts and events.

food.name: Maxwell Food Centre
food.description: Famous hawker centre in Chinatown housing numerous legendary food stalls, including Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice.

food.name: Lau Pa Sat
food.description: Historic Victorian-style cast-iron hawker market in the financial district, famous for evening satay street stalls.

food.name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
food.description: Traditional kopitiam chain famous for kaya toast, soft-boiled eggs, and local Nanyang coffee.

food.name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh
food.description: Popular casual eatery serving tender pork rib soup steeped in a peppery, garlic-infused broth.

food.name: Zam Zam Restaurant
food.description: Historic Indian-Muslim restaurant operating since 1908, famous for murtabak and biryani.

food.name: Newton Food Centre
food.description: Open-air hawker complex famous for BBQ seafood and local dishes, featured in the film Crazy Rich Asians.

food.name: Amoy Street Food Centre
food.description: Vibrant two-story hawker centre in the CBD featuring a mix of traditional hawker fare and Michelin-recommended stalls.

food.name: TIONG BAHRU BAKERY
food.description: Artisan French bakery known for handcrafted croissants, pastries, and specialty coffee in a trendy neighborhood.

food.name: Komala Vilas
food.description: Long-running vegetarian South Indian restaurant in Little India serving traditional thali and dosas.

accommodation.name: CapsulePod@Aljunied
accommodation.description: Modern capsule hostel providing clean, private sleeping pods for budget travelers near a main MRT station.

accommodation.name: Champion Hotel
accommodation.description: Peranakan-inspired boutique hotel situated in the culturally rich Joo Chiat heritage district.

accommodation.name: MET A Space Pod at Chinatown
accommodation.description: Sci-fi themed capsule hostel located directly in the hustle and bustle of Chinatown.

shopping.name: Mustafa Centre
shopping.description: Massive 24-hour department store in Little India selling everything from groceries and electronics to gold jewelry.

shopping.name: Bugis Street Market
shopping.description: Sprawling market complex popular for bargain fashion, souvenirs, accessories, and street snacks.

shopping.name: Chinatown Street Market
shopping.description: Traditional street market set inside historical shophouses selling Chinese handicrafts, souvenirs, and traditional clothing.

shopping.name: Haji Lane
shopping.description: Narrow alleyway famous for independent local boutiques, vintage clothing stores, vibrant murals, and indie cafes.

shopping.name: Little India Arcade
shopping.description: Colorful historical arcade offering Indian textiles, traditional sweets, spices, and intricate jewelry.
